text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ مَّآ أَشْهَدتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ ٱلْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًۭا

words.gloss_range: opening negative particle selecting perfect-verb negation
words.prose: The opening {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) fixes the ayah in denial before any created domain is named. It selects negation before the perfect verb, so the first claim is not a question or relative phrase but a categorical denial that the pronoun group was granted witness-access. Its position also starts the larger chain of denials that will move from cosmic creation to self-creation and then to the refusal of misleaders as support. The held opening negative beat is only a secondary recitational payoff, but it helps the denial arrive with audible weight.

topics.headline: opening negation governs witness-access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by denying an event of granted witnessing, not by asking a question or naming an object first.
topics.reason: The particle stands before the perfect verb {{ar:أَشْهَدْتُهُمْ}} ({{tr:ashhadtuhum}}), and the clause evidence treats it as negative.

topics.headline: first beat in a linked denial chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first denial as the start of an evidentiary sequence that excludes the group from witnessed authority before the objects are named.
topics.reason: The first negator is followed by later correlative and second-predicate negations, so the opening denial is structurally linked to the rest of the ayah.

topics.headline: opening sound-weight is secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may notice that the opening negative beat is acoustically held, while the normalized local evidence still makes grammar the main payoff.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows describe an extended or doubled opening surface; QAC gives normalized {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), so the payoff survives only as recitational emphasis, not as a separate grammatical claim.

words.gloss_range: causative witnessing-access denied to the attached plural object
words.root_gloss_range: witnessing as presence, testimony, and caused access; the local Form IV construction selects caused witness-access
words.prose: {{ar:أَشْهَدْتُهُمْ}} ({{tr:ashhadtuhum}}) is not simple witnessing; Form IV makes witness-access something the speaker would have caused or granted. The attached object suffix keeps the excluded group from 18:50 inside the verb, so the denial strips Iblis and his offspring of any creation-scene standing or testimony-authority. The verb governs both creation objects, making the withheld access stretch from the heavens and earth to their own selves, while creation-witness echoes elsewhere (37:150, 41:21, 43:19) remain parallels rather than controllers of the local parse. Variant voice pressure and the clipped witness-root onset sharpen the denial without changing the causative mechanism.

topics.reason: Form IV, the attached person-object, and the governed {{ar:خَلْقَ}} ({{tr:khalqa}}) objects all support caused witness-access.

Its construct position binds creation to the cosmic pair while leaving the Creator implicit. The root range makes that creation feel ordered, formed, and measured, while the fabrication branch is narrowed to polemical contrast against fabricated authority. The word also begins the exact repetition that will move from outer creation to the group’s own selves, returning Surah 18 creation reminders such as 18:37 and 18:48 as witness-denial.

The construct governs {{ar:الْمُضِلِّينَ}} ({{tr:al-muḍillīna}}), so the predicate carries the clause toward the final support noun. Variant and shaddah pressure sharpen the adoption predicate without changing the refusal.

words.gloss_range: definite plural causative active participle naming agents who mislead
words.root_gloss_range: straying, causing to stray, confusion, loss, and disappearance; local Form IV active participle selects misguiding agency
words.prose: {{ar:الْمُضِلِّينَ}} ({{tr:al-muḍillīna}}) is governed by the construct participle before it, so the refused adoptees are a definite class of misguiding agents. The Form IV active participle makes them cause others to stray, not merely be lost themselves, and the plural treats them as rational agents. The d-l-l field adds disorientation, path-loss, and even disappearance into loss as color, while the local noun remains causative agency. After 18:50’s Iblis narrative, the word turns narrative identity into a category: those who mislead are precisely the class named just before the support-role they cannot occupy. The surah’s guidance/loss vocabulary and the dual-variant pressure stay secondary to that plural class reading.

words.gloss_range: indefinite support-role noun completing the refused adoption frame
words.root_gloss_range: upper arm, strengthening support, helper, firmness, and mutual reinforcement; local predicate frame selects abstract helper/support with embodied force
words.prose: {{ar:عَضُدًا}} ({{tr:ʿaḍudan}}) is the clause’s final landing: the role into which misleaders are refused. Its indefinite singular form denies even one support-role, while the body-part range of upper arm and helper makes support concrete and load-bearing rather than generic assistance. Firm-branch and arm-strength images add firmness to that support metaphor, under the local helper/support sense. The rare word and dense vocalization variants mark the close, and the echo with 28:35 reverses strengthening language: what can elsewhere name reinforcement is here denied to misleaders. The final tanwīn gives the refusal a clipped closure, so the ayah lands on rejected relational and structural dependence rather than only on unwitnessed origins.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled denial of witnessing attaches to both cosmic creation and the creation of their own selves.
baseline_models.mechanism: Witnessing as presence and inspection is denied at acts of measured formation; neither observation nor consultation gives the addressed beings standing in origination.

activation_trace.role: Presence with direct viewing supplies the denied observer position at creation.
Measuring and determining a thing frames both creation phrases as prior ordering, not a witnessed consultation.

changed_reading.before: They were simply absent from a past event.
changed_reading.after: Their absence denies observational or consultative standing in the measured origination of cosmos and selves.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence pairs the heavens and earth with the creation of the addressees' own selves.
baseline_models.mechanism: The outermost domain and the beings' own identities are both brought into being; those whose very selves occupy the created side cannot be co-authors of either scale.

activation_trace.role: Bringing into being governs both the cosmic and reflexive objects.
What is above and overshadows supplies the upper pole of the created whole.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the lower pole of the created whole.
The thing's own self or identity turns createdness reflexively upon the addressees.

changed_reading.before: The verse only denies help in making the external cosmos.
changed_reading.after: It closes both scales at once: the whole outside them and the selves from which any rival claim would arise are created without them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins taking, active misguidance, and an arm-like source of reinforcement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The denial is not bare lack of need: it rejects acquiring agents who divert from the aim as a strengthening side of divine action.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition and adoption supply the rejected act of recruiting support.
Departure from guidance and intended direction makes the proposed agents functionally unfit.
A helper who strengthens a companion supplies the denied reinforcement relation.

changed_reading.before: God merely did not need bad assistants.
changed_reading.after: The clause rejects incorporating direction-distorting agents into the very support structure of divine action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured ordering, vegetal breakup, wind dispersal, and return as first created make creaturely form dependent across formation, decay, and reappearance; exclusion from witnessing is structural, not a missed apprenticeship.

activation_trace.role: Denied presence at creation anchors the question of whether creatures ever occupied an apprentice-observer position.
Ordering an affair by measure supplies deliberate governance of the transient process.
Dry broken vegetation supplies the loss of a creaturely form.
Wind-driven winnowing supplies dispersal after the form breaks.
Being brought as first created supplies reappearance under the Creator's agency.

structural_cues: 18:45 sequences flourishing into dry fragments dispersed by wind; 18:48 returns the addressed group as first created.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measurement, dissolution, dispersal, and first creation; I infer a formation-decay-return arc that rules out apprenticeship. Alternatively, the scenes may only juxtapose transience and resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The addressees happened not to attend the first making.
changed_reading.after: Across measured formation, unmaking, and return they remain managed creatures, never apprentices admitted into creative agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those denied a witness-position at origination are later exposed, presented, and accompanied by a binding record that makes their deeds present; their evidentiary role reverses from absent observers to observed subjects.

activation_trace.role: Presence with viewing supplies the witness-position denied at origination.
Exposure and uncovering begin the later scene of visibility.
Bringing something forward for inspection makes the addressees objects of view.
A written fixation that entails judgment supplies binding evidence.
Presence and nearness make their own deeds the material now in attendance.

structural_cues: 18:47-49 moves from exposure and gathering through ranked presentation to a record in which every deed is found present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied witnessing, later exposure, inspection, record, and presence; I infer an evidentiary role reversal. Alternatively, the sequence may evoke accountability without a technical courtroom model.

changed_reading.before: They were not eyewitnesses to creation.
changed_reading.after: They lack standing as witnesses to origination but become fully visible subjects whose own acts arrive as evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans are challenged for taking Iblis and his progeny as protective allies in substitution for God, while the focus speaker categorically refuses to take misleaders as reinforcing aides; the two recruitment directions are deliberately unequal.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition supplies the focus speaker's rejected recruitment.
A strengthening helper defines the office into which no misleader is admitted.
The same acquisitive taking supplies the humans' contrary recruitment of false allies.
Protective affection and alliance specify what the humans seek from the recruited figures.
One thing standing in another's place exposes the alliance as a bad substitution.

structural_cues: 18:50 immediately precedes the focus and asks whether Iblis and his progeny are taken as allies instead of the speaker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated taking, alliance, substitution, and denied support; I infer a reciprocal contrast between whom humans recruit and whom God never recruits. Alternatively, 18:50 may only identify the pronoun's referents.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a general assertion that God uses no wicked assistants.
changed_reading.after: It answers a bad human alliance with an asymmetry: they install misleaders as patrons, but divine action never installs those misleaders as its supporting arm.

context_deltas.mechanism: Alleged partners are summoned, fail to answer, and are separated by a barrier; the abstract denial of an assisting arm becomes an operational test in which the supposed support channel cannot function.

activation_trace.role: The strengthening helper supplies the support function put to the later test.
Partnership supplies the alleged relation whose efficacy is tested.
Calling by speech initiates the attempted support transaction.
Verbal response supplies the expected return that the negated verb withholds.
A barrier between parties makes the failed support relation spatially explicit.

structural_cues: 18:52 follows the focus with an imperative to call the alleged partners, then reports no response and a barrier between the parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies partner, summons, nonresponse, and barrier; I infer a functional test of the denied helper relation. Alternatively, the scene may primarily stage punishment rather than demonstrate incapacity.

changed_reading.after: The denied partnership is also nonfunctional in real time: when invoked, it yields neither answer nor access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The selves that did not witness their own making later forget, bear covered hearts, and fail to understand or receive direction; dependence in origin is joined to opacity within the very faculties that might claim self-knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The mind and inward awareness within the self supply the claimed site of self-knowledge.
Departure from guidance links origin-opacity to the focus category of active misdirection.
Leaving and neglecting what was advanced supplies a failure of interior retention.
The heart supplies the inner faculty placed under covering.
Comprehension supplies the capacity that the covering prevents.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies the orientation they cannot attain.

structural_cues: 18:57 moves inward from forgotten deeds to covered hearts and failed understanding, then ends with failed guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unwitnessed self-creation and later failures of memory, heart, understanding, and guidance; I infer that the self is not transparent enough to ground its own origin claims. Alternatively, 18:57 may describe moral consequence without making an epistemology of the self.

changed_reading.before: They lack historical information about how their bodies began.
changed_reading.after: Their exclusion reaches inward: even the present self is an unreliable witness to its source and direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shared taking-root reverses the relation: the Creator does not acquire misleaders as aides, but may take them to account for what they acquire, after which no refuge is found.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition supplies the categorical refusal to take misleaders into service.
Taking for an offense reverses the same root from recruitment into accountability.
Acquiring gain supplies the agents' own earned basis for being taken to account.
Refuge and escape supply the protection that will not be found beyond the appointed delay.

structural_cues: 18:58 contrasts a conditional immediate taking-to-account with merciful delay and an appointed time at which no refuge is found.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two branches of the same taking-root, earned acts, delay, and absent refuge; I infer an actor-object reversal from refused recruitment to possible seizure. Alternatively, the echo may be ordinary polysemy rather than a designed reversal.

changed_reading.before: The focus only says whom God does not employ.
changed_reading.after: It also anticipates the opposite relation: those never taken into divine service remain liable to be taken for what they themselves acquired.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it presses a body-part image across the nearby self-language; it remains anchored in the creation of selves and the literal arm branch of support, but downstream prose should present it as an embodied analogy, not anatomy or doctrine.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verse moves from the creation of their own selves to refusing misleaders as an arm.

activation_trace.role: Completed bodily form supplies the embodied field in which the arm image can resonate.
The life-bearing self supplies the created organism that owns limbs but did not author itself.
The upper arm supplies a literal bodily image for an aide incorporated into agency.

changed_reading.before: An assistant is compared conventionally to an arm.
changed_reading.after: Created selves possess dependent limbs, while no misleader is grafted into divine agency as an executive limb.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the split mapped root و س م under the source root س م و; it remains valid as a branch-backed resonance with the focus's sign-witness branch, but downstream prose must say 'may echo' and must not replace the primary sense of heavens.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The denied witnessing of the heavens' creation stands beside branch images of a visible mark and a sign that bears witness.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark lets the created heavens resonate as legible evidence after their making.
A sign that testifies converts visible creation from an observed workshop into subsequent evidence.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only an object whose making they did not observe.
changed_reading.after: The heavens may also echo as created marks that testify after the fact, sharply separating evidence of creation from attendance at creation.

strongest_changes: The 18:50 adjacency reverses recruitment: humans take false allies, while divine action never takes misleaders as its strengthening arm.
The 18:47-49 sequence reverses evidentiary position: absent witnesses to origination become exposed subjects whose deeds are present.
The repeated taking-root in 18:58 turns refused acquisition of aides into possible taking-to-account of agents.
summary.what_was_special: The local window repeatedly converts the focus's static denials into relational reversals: observer versus exhibit, recruiter versus recruited, helper versus failed respondent, and acquisition versus accountability.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus-only baseline cannot identify the pronoun's referents; 18:50 strongly orients them without resolving every possible scope.
The evidentiary reading is coherent but need not imply a technical courtroom scene.
The created-mark outlier depends on a split mapped root and must remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Unwitnessed origins disqualify borrowed authority.** `ك و ن` B001 (“being, occurrence, or temporal predication”) is negated in the relation “I was not taking,” after creation scenes to which the alleged helpers were not witnesses. The hidden teacher later acts from imparted knowledge (18:65), while Moses’ lack of encompassing report limits his judgment (18:68). I infer that assistance in governance requires epistemic participation; misleaders possess neither. Their advisory status is causally impossible, not merely unwanted.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:65 and 18:82 supplied the positive contrast: a servant can act from received knowledge while denying autonomous command.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **False counsel rejected as a load-bearing limb.** `ع ض د/B001` is the upper arm, while `ع ض د/B002` is a helper or supporting arm. The rejected allies of 18:50 precede the denial that misleaders witnessed creation; in 18:52 the claimed partners fail to answer, and a separating gulf is placed between them. I infer that valid support would require epistemic access to the work it supposedly helps bear. `عَضُدًا` reads as a structural test of counsel: misleaders cannot be treated as load-bearing participants in creation or judgment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:52’s unanswered summons provided the practical test: a supposed supporting arm cannot answer or bridge the relation it claims to bear.

branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل مختلق تام الخلق؛ المختلق من كل شيء ما اعتدل (maqayis)؛ رجل خليق أي تم خلقه؛ المختلق من كل شيء ما اعتدل (ayn)؛ رجل خليق ومختلق أي تام الخلق معتدل؛ مضغة مخلقة أي تامة الخلق (sihah)؛ رجل خليق إذا تم خلقه؛ مخلقة قد بدا خلقها وغير مخلقة لم تصور (tahdhib)؛ خص الخلق بالهيئات والأشكال والصور المدركة بالبصر (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الخلق والخليقة والطبيعة والسليقة والفطرة والمروءة والدين من جهة الصفة الباطنة والمعاشرة بها.
يدخل فيه خليق بكذا، أخلق به، مخلقة للخير، وما يكون الشخص كأنه مهيأ أو مقدر لذلك.
يدخل فيه الخلاق بمعنى النصيب والحظ، ولا سيما النصيب من الخير أو الآخرة أو الدين.
يدخل فيه خلق الكذب واختلاقه وتخلقه، الكلام المزور أو المفتعل، والخرافات المنسوبة أو المنحولة.
يدخل فيه الأملس المصمت، الصخرة الخلقاء، استواء السحاب أو الرسم، السهم أو القدح أو الحبل المملس، ومواضع الجبهة والوجه والظهر والغار المسماة خلقاء أو خليقاء.
يدخل فيه خلق الثوب وأخلق، الثوب الخلق والأخلاق، التمزق والبلى وذهاب الزئبر أو أثر الاستعمال.
يدخل فيه الخلوق المعروف من الطيب، التخليق والتخلق به، وطلاء غيره بالخلوق.
يدخل فيه الخليقة بمعنى النقرة في الصفا أو الصخرة يجتمع فيها ماء السماء، والدحلان والآبار الحديثة الحفر.
يدخل فيه وصف المرأة الرتقاء أو الخلقاء من جهة الانسداد والإصمات المشبه بالصفاة الخلقاء.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ortak fiziksel işaretleme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; zırhın alt bölümündeki süslemeyi anlatan özel tamlama yalnızca kendi sözlüksel karşılığında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ya da hayvanı, tanınmasını veya ayırt edilmesini sağlayan kalıcı ve görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturacak biçimde işaretlemektir; iz yakma, kulak kesme ya da çentikleme yoluyla bırakılabilir. Anlam alanı, oluşan işareti ve özellikle hayvanı işaretlemeye yarayan kızgın aracı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesne veya hayvan üzerinde onu tanıtmaya ve başkalarından ayırmaya yarayan görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturulur.
İşaret, kızgın araçla yakılarak, kulağın bir bölümü kesilerek veya çentik açılarak bırakılabilir.
Eylemin sonucunda kalan tanıtıcı iz de aynı anlam alanında adlandırılır.
Özellikle hayvanlara bu izi koymak için kullanılan kızgın işaretleme aracı da bu dala bağlıdır.

يدخل فيه الشرب بنفس أو أنفاس، والنفس بمعنى الجرعة أو المستراح في الشرب.
يدخل فيه النفس أو النفسين من الدباغ، أي مقدار يسير يدبغ به الجلد مرة أو مرتين.
يدخل فيه تسمية الماء نفسا، والشراب ذو النفس إذا كان فيه سعة وري، ونقيضه الشراب غير ذي نفس.
يدخل فيه تنفس الصبح والنهار إذا تبلج أو امتد، وتنفس القوس إذا انشقت، وزيادة الماء أو الموج حين يخرجان أو ينتشران.
يدخل فيه النفيس والنفاسة والمنفس، والرغبة والمنافسة في الشيء، والضن أو الحسد به إذا كان لقيمته ورغبة النفس فيه.

يدخل فيه الأخذة رقية تأخذ العين، والتأخيذ والسحر أو الخرزة التي تحبس الرجل أو المرأة عن النكاح أو الرأي.
يدخل فيه الإخاذة بمعنى الضيعة أو الأرض التي يأخذها الإنسان أو السلطان لنفسه ويحوزها ويحييها.
يدخل فيه الإخاذ والإخاذة والإخذ: مجتمع ماء أو حوض أو حفرة تمسك الماء أياما، وما يشبه الغدير.
يدخل فيه أخذ المرض أو الرمد، والمستأخذ المستكين لمرضه، وأخذ البعير أو الشاة كهيئة الجنون، وتخمة الفصيل، وأخذ السمن في الإبل.
يدخل فيه نجوم الأخذ، وهي منازل القمر، وتسميتها لأن القمر يأخذ كل ليلة في منزل أو نوء.
يدخل فيه أخذ إخذ القوم أو أخذهم، أي السير بسيرتهم أو أخذ شكلهم وخلائقهم وهديهم.

root_profile.summary: Kök, iki ana eksen taşır: üst kol beden bölümü çevresinde yardım ve dayanak, üst kola fiziksel temas, yan destek, yana yönelme, deve hastalığı, takı ve damga gibi dallar; ayrıca ağaç veya kemik kesme çevresinde kesme eylemi, kesici kişi, araç ve kesilmiş parça adları.
